name: CURVE- Seagrass Defence
summary: Coastal Underwater Research: Virtual Experiences are a series of virtual reality (VR) modules to provide virtual research experience to academic individuals in the marine science field. This particular module features tools and techniques used for a real-world experiment conducted by Erin Johnson. Users can learn about and conduct essential fieldwork tasks needed to run an experiment that investigates how seagrass defenses affect sea urchin consumption.
